summary: Preserve service conflicts and failed-removal errors for installed but unloaded systemd user units without probing absent manager names.

replay.detail: No claim format or replay change.

compatibility.detail: Loaded-only observations are combined with local systemd user-unit search paths to detect installed but unloaded service aliases, including masked entries. Failed stop or disable commands are ignored only when neither installed files nor active manager state establish that the unit exists. System-manager unit paths are not searched and absent service names are not queried through show.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon to activate the corrected installed-unit discovery. No user-manager reset is required.

manual.detail: No migration or new configuration is required.

recovery.detail: Conflicting service families and failed mutations of installed units remain explicit errors; resolve the reported conflict or permission error before retrying.
